profile: Rayonier Advanced Materials manufactures cellulose specialties and other cellulose-based products and derivatives. Its materials are used in filters, food, pharmaceuticals, high-performance plastics, propellants, and industrial applications. The company also produces cellulose viscose pulp, cellulose fluff pulp, high-yield pulp, paperboard, biofuels, bioelectricity, and lignin. Its business segments include Cellulose Specialties, Biomaterials, Cellulose Commodities, Paperboard, and High-Yield Pulp.
